source.prompt: An Olympic marmot (Marmota olympus), a large heavy ground squirrel, NOT a beaver, NOT a groundhog cartoon. One adult standing on all four short legs, side-on neutral pose, legs with clear gaps, head level. Realistic proportions: 70 cm long including a bushy 20 cm tail held out behind, a broad heavy body, a broad blunt head with small round ears, short strong legs with dark claws. Brown fur grizzled with pale tips, a white muzzle and a white band in front of the eyes, a darker crown. No base, no ground. Game-ready, clean closed mesh.

tiers.note: Whisker strands and cheek tufts dropped (inward ray cast, the ears kept); the hanging tail removed and a bushy one lofted from its root. lod0 = body 1,544 + tail (10 sides x 12 rings, 240) + eyes (16); lod1 = 516 + tail (6 x 7, 84); lod2 = 148 + tail (4 x 4, 32). GLB 181,404 bytes.

rig: Rodent template, exactly as client/assets/ground_squirrel.glb (tools/build_ground_squirrel.py, the sentinel sit-up) and to be loaded with its constants and its colony behaviour: BODY 0 (hindquarters), CHEST 7 (pivot at the lumbar: flexes with the bound, rises to sit up), HEAD 6 (pivot at the base of the neck) and LEG_A 1 (fore pair, elbows) children of the chest, LEG_B 2 (hind pair, stifles), TAIL 3 and TAIL_TIP 8 (child of the tail). The legs are the parts below the elbow / stifle height outside the belly's middle (the belly nearly touches the ground). extras.rig keys: kind 'rodent', chest [0, 0.175, -0.072], tail [0, 0.174, -0.227], tail_tip [0, 0.164, -0.318], head [0, 0.212, 0.150], fore [0.100, 0.072, 0.074], hind [0.107, 0.072, -0.093], length_m 0.7. The ground squirrel's drop (0.016 m) and sit angle were set for a 0.26 m animal; the lead may want drop ~0.03 and a lower sit for this heavy body. No skin.
accuracy_notes: Reads as a big heavy marmot: a broad body on short legs, a broad blunt head with small round ears, a white muzzle and chin and a white band in front of the eyes under a darker brown crown and face, grizzled brown fur with pale buff tips (hashed), a pale buff-brown belly, dark feet, a bushy brown tail with a darker tip. Still open: the grizzle is face-sized patches (coarse up close); the white band and muzzle are region cuts on decimated faces, a little blocky; the eyes are small octahedra on lod0 only (one dark face on lod1); the tail is a lofted tube, less bushy than life; the body is the generator's (perhaps a touch tall in the hump). The sentinel sit-up was tuned for the ground squirrel and has not been looked at on this body.
